mapper.select: select a.sha256_code_list, a.api_code, a.local_id, a.id from b_xiecheng_sms_colliding_data_vt a left join b_xiecheng_sms_colliding_data_log_vt b on a.sha256_code_list = b.sha256_code_list and b.send_date = #{sendDate} and b.status in(1,2,3) where a.local_id = #{localId} and b.id is null limit #{xieChengSmsCollidingDataVtPageSize}
select * from b_xiecheng_sms_colliding_data_vt where sha256_code_list = #{sha256Tel} and next_push_time is not null order by next_push_time desc limit 1
